open: The actual Initiative-to-Execution handoff adapter/receipt is owner-gated and was explicitly excluded. Candidate materialization and governed lifecycle gate are proven, but this packet does not claim the final downstream Execution handoff.

changedPathRationale.server/src/services/initiative/initiativ: Compensates the losing A-vs-A acceptance race so exactly one Initiative row remains.
changedPathRationale.server/src/routes/initiativeCandidates.r: Revalidates ACTIVE organization membership before every mounted candidate read/write.
changedPathRationale.server/src/services/initiative/__tests__: Strengthens the concurrency invariant from one-or-two rows to exactly one.
Adds real JWT, mounted route, tenant, stale-membership, concurrent acceptance and independent cold-readback proof.

commands.command: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:32939/ini_bvp DB_TYPE=postgres CI=true RUN_DB_TESTS=1 MOCK_DB=false NODE_ENV=test npx vitest run server/src/services/initiative/__tests__/ini-bvp-001-candidate-single-materialization.pg.test.ts server/src/services/initiative/__tests__/ini-bvp-001-mounted-auth.pg.test.ts server/src/services/initiative/__tests__/ini-mvp-gate-001-lifecycle-gate-writer.pg.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1 --retry=0 --reporter=dot

fixtures.tenants: two organizations; active owner in each plus inactive stale owner in source tenant
fixtures.auth: real signed JWT through mounted initiativeCandidates router
fixtures.candidate: classic candidate plus event-sourced runtime-v1 candidate contracts
fixtures.database: fresh isolated PostgreSQL, removed after proof

negativeControls.classicConcurrency: two simultaneous acceptCandidate calls converge on one receipt ID and exactly one initiatives row
negativeControls.crossSubsystemConcurrency: classic and runtime-v1 acceptance converge to exactly one claim column and no orphan
negativeControls.tenant: foreign organization acceptance returns 404 and writes nothing
negativeControls.lifecycleCapability: governed lifecycle gate writer suite covers role/capability, stale version and same-ID transition controls
negativeControls.coldReadback: independent pg.Client reopens accepted candidate joined to exactly one Initiative
negativeControls.cleanup: post-suite candidate and Initiative prefix residue queries both returned zero

rollback.method: Remove the A-vs-A compensation branch, route membership middleware and the mounted proof. No migration or production data rollback is required.
